title: Knowledge, charm and a true passion
text: Alba is a wonderful guide. She combines deep historical knowledge with a real passion for Seville. She shows the well-known sights, but also shares fascinating stories, hidden gems and insights about the city and its personalities. If you want to discover Seville beyond the obvious, Alba is the perfect guide. Highly recommended!
author: simonelG3069BF

title: loved our enjoyable, informative and highly personalized walking tour of Sevilla
text: Mila was an excellent tour guide!  She was deeply knowledgeable about the history and of cross-cultural aspects of Sevilla and of Spain.  She showed as lots of specific details we could never have appreciated on our own.  Also her English was excellent.  My husband and I have been on many tours, of varying levels of quality, and Mila stood out as one of the best guides we've ever had!

title: Excellent Seville tour
text: Laura with Giralda tours provided a very informative and fun tour of Seville. Our travel agent booked the same tour twice for us and Laura was able to give us a completely different and comprehensive tour with very little notice. She is incredibly knowledgeable and passionate about the history of Seville. I highly recommend Laura as a guide for an insiders view and experience.
author: G2990BEtjb

title: Such fun! An enthusiastic, knowledgeable and friendly guide.
text:
We had a brilliant tour of the historical centre of Seville with Alba. She was there when we got there and from the start she was friendly, enthusiastic and funny. 
We had never visited Seville before but after the tour we were very well prepared to enjoy the rest of our visit. The sites she selected were fascinating and she has a wealth of information at her fingertips. 
The route was appropriate for our level of mobility and the whole tour was well paced. 
We had a wonderful time and now share her enthusiasm for this beautiful and fascinating city. We could not have been in better hands!
author: JeremyP56

title: Amazing tour
text:
Im so glad we booked this private walking tour of Seville!  Beatriz, our tour guide was amazing!  She spoke very good English, was easy to understand.  And boy did she have a lot to say!! We walked away from this tour with so much information!  It was easy to tell that Beatriz loves what she does and loves Seville!  She took us to places that must definitely we would have missed and we really enjoyed the one on one attention we received!
Thank you Beatriz for making this tour  the one will never forget!
